correctness.rationale: Fix y≥1 and pairwise distinct primes r_j,s_j>y for 1≤j≤y. CRT gives a unique reduced class a mod M=product r_js_j with a≡−j mod r_js_j. Every prime q≡a (mod M) gives q+j divisible by distinct primes r_j,s_j for all j, so no q+1,…,q+y is a prime power. q itself is prime, hence the largest prime power ≤q+y is q and the defining non-prime-power branch yields P(q+y)=y. Dirichlet ensures infinitely many q; the PNT in fixed reduced residue class proves liminf F_y(X)log X/X≥1/phi(M). Checked no use of only finite experiments to obtain the universal asymptotic and independently reconstructed explicit small-y CRT examples.
